name: Triad — Temporal‑Correction Surfaces
summary: Defines the temporal-correction surfaces of the Triad system, including corrected-time geometry, temporal drift compensation, and cross-layer temporal binding.
purpose: Provide the temporal-correction geometry used by Scanner, O.H.S.H.I.T., and Atlas to stabilize reasoning across time windows, correct illusionary-time distortion, and maintain cross-domain temporal alignment.
